blocks.heading: Message and Email Scripts You Can Edit
rows: Hi [name], I am [role/college]. I read about your move from [X] to [Y]. Could I ask two quick questions about how you chose [Y]?
Subject: Two questions on [field] from a fellow [college] student. Body: who you are, one line of homework, one question, thanks.
Thank you for the advice on [topic]. I did [action] and learned [result]. May I send you a short update in a month?
Hi [name], following up on my note from last week. No pressure if you are busy.
